limitations: No held-out evaluation corpus or label store exists yet: evaluation.plan.json pins the design (300 clean + 300 supported-failure pages across >=12 mechanism/layout groups, custodian-issued labels) and `status` honestly reports all targets UNMET. Generating the held-out corpus and labels is future custodian work; the plan's split_manifests entries for evaluation/permissioned stay null until issued.

The protocol is exercised on synthetic corpora/labels plus the frozen T05 fixtures; no real inspection engine exists to produce inspection_run records yet, so evaluate() was verified on synthetic bound runs, not a real inspector output.

Development/public_demo scoring expects a labels file in the eval-labels schema (--labels); deriving dev truth from T05 expectation files is a documented bridge, not implemented here (not required by the criteria).
Alignment p95/max and repeatability metrics are wired through run-provided alignment_errors_px/repeat_digests; real fiducial measurement belongs to the inspection engine tasks.

F01 mapping-control and F07 geometry-control are byte-identical in the frozen T05 fixtures, so F01+F07 correctly union into one lineage cluster (conservative: wider bootstrap intervals, same split). If the fixture catalog intends them independent, the bytes must diverge upstream in the generator - recorded, not hidden.
Python: contract command uses `python`; this host provides only `python3` (3.14.7). The acceptance registry maps it; recorded here for honesty.
No independent review exists yet: review.md/acceptance.json are coordinator-written artifacts produced at acceptance time; this handoff is a worker receipt, not acceptance.
acceptance_notes: A worker receipt is not coordinator acceptance. acceptance_receipts.criterion_evidence consumes receipt.json's acceptance_criteria_evidence dict (exact criterion keys, status executed, task-local evidence paths); record_acceptance additionally requires the verified run.json (bound), commands.log, and a committed independent review.md from a reviewer != worker.
